result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, my top recommendation is **Stripe**\. However, depending on how your store is built, Square or Shopify Payments could be a better fit.

Here's how I'd compare the main options in November 2026.

## Best payment processors compared

![Stripe Logo Download (SVG, PNG, EPS, PDF) | PixelBrands](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aVtuLxJXV9DmtEmg9b45Apl_aIYsif99dM-GHSfkXYZDC4tFOhFvFlTrHocFw_PqD4iGlfn8TyGj8Knz3iEfgQ88Gl1qbf-qVS8yq3s_dga8IuVvdS85dQWTHuxQAfDBHQSn4bvLAWea6XSgqDlmrU-sz5LlptntGZmOFqqabVil8_uydbbIqAvaqwgrj-k8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

# 1.5% + 20p

Standard UK cards

- No monthly fees.
- Easy integration with most ecommerce platforms.
- Apple Pay, Google Pay and subscriptions.
- Excellent reporting and fraud prevention.

Website: [Stripe UK](https://stripe.com/gb)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Square**

(Best for beginners)

# 1.4% + 25p

UK online card payments

- Free entry-level online store.
- Straightforward setup.
- Excellent if you also sell in person.
- Payment links and online checkout.

Website: [Square UK](https://squareup.com/gb/en)

---

![Shopify Payments en México 2026: Comisiones y Cuándo Conviene | Atémpora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uaDWm9NONCBgwuJmZgfert_G31d46hLlI4IfJXvnluf3W2KNJh1m0Hd6lZrNGAPmsyHRrilMlk9B4682s-cn40d1cp-SjQrlAzuD2UEX8iNzkLVIhiPrHZ-Q-BYlhpFfZG8FNzWKzH1o7gk5YwcfdyrA6rRsIlL4g3Z9SJ_DAnqpO6UXb7hjSC1HIAun6cGh?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

# 2% + 25p

Basic plan, standard online cards

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- No separate payment gateway setup.
- Easy refunds and order management.
- Avoids Shopify's additional third-party transaction fee.

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**

(Best as an additional option)

# 2.9% + 30p

Typical domestic commercial transactions

- Many customers already have accounts.
- Familiar checkout experience.
- Useful for customer confidence.
- Can be offered alongside Stripe.

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

Rates are headline UK pricing and can vary by card type, payment method and plan. Sources: [stripe.com](https://stripe.com/GB/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[squareup.com](https://squareup.com/gb/en/legal/general/fees?country_redirection=true&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/uk/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.paypal.com](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business/paypal-business-fees?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What would I choose?

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Small independent online store | Stripe |
| Shopify website | Shopify Payments |
| First-time business owner | Square |
| Selling internationally | Stripe |
| Want customers to have PayPal | Add PayPal alongside Stripe |
| Selling online and at markets | Square |
